galaxy_setting.name: CanHackShields
galaxy_setting.display_name: 护盾 Generators Can Be Hacked
galaxy_setting.description: By default, 护盾 Generators can be hacked. Disabling this will remove the option to hack 护盾 Generators, forcing the player to destroy more Command 站s and thus incur more AI Progress.

galaxy_setting.name: CanOverload
galaxy_setting.display_name: 核心护盾s Can Be Overloaded
galaxy_setting.description: Determines whether 核心护盾s can be overloaded if a non-player faction destroys the Command 站 on a 堡垒 World. If Enabled, this will result in the destruction of all 核心护盾s and 护盾 Generators owned by the owner of the Command 站, leaving them vulnerable to the attacking faction.

galaxy_setting.name: CanPlayerAlliesOverload
galaxy_setting.display_name: Allied Factions Can Overload 核心护盾s
galaxy_setting.description: By default, factions allied to the player cannot overload a 核心护盾 even if they destroy an appropriate Command 站 as allowing them to do so can result in cheese. If this is enabled, this restriction will be removed assuming that Overloading is also enabled.
